text:
leo: Noticed a small recurring spike of TLS handshake stalls on cross-region routes (us-west-2 -> eu-west-1) after last night's deploy. Logs show cipher-negotiation hang + retries. Need owners + quick mitigations.

rachel: I can pick up immediate mitigation: add a stricter fail-fast on handshake after 3 retries and prefer regional path. Will run a 2% canary. ETA: 24h.

sam: I'll take telemetry + postmortem scope. Need to add cipher-suite breakdown to the retry dashboard and run a replay of failed handshakes. ETA: 72h.

leo: sample log: 
```
2026-03-23T11:02:10Z edge lb us-west-2 -> eu-west-1 TLS handshake stall cipher=ECDHE-RSA-AES128-GCM-SHA256 retries=7
```

rachel: created task SRE-2401 to implement fail-fast + prefer-regional. Canary plan in the ticket.

infra-bot: Created task <https://tasks.redwood/s/SRE-2401|SRE-2401> assigned to rachel. Due: 2026-03-24 12:00 UTC.

sam: telemetry query I'll use: `SELECT cipher, count(*) FROM lb_handshakes WHERE retries>1 AND src='us-west-2' GROUP BY cipher`  will post dashboard tile.

rachel: launching canary: `deploy --svc lb-router --canary 2% --image:sha:de9f`  monitoring now.

leo: note on recurrence: we've seen similar patterns on cross-region scale-up events + when older cipher suites are preferred by certain client IPs. Agree on a longer-term remediation: 1) enforce cipher consistency via TLS profile, 2) CI handshake matrix, 3) routing sticky fix.

sam: added SRE-2402 to own telemetry + postmortem artifacts. Linking SRE-2401 <https://tasks.redwood/s/SRE-2402|SRE-2402>. ETA: 2026-03-26.

rachel: canary metrics: retries dropped from 1.9% -> 0.6% on canary. Rolling to 10% to validate.

leo: good. Owners/timeline recap: rachel (SRE-2401) fail-fast + canary -> 24h; sam (SRE-2402) telemetry + postmortem -> 72h; follow-up CI work -> 1w. Check-in tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
